label: Ebay

discovery.auth: OAuth2 (client credentials for Browse; user token for Sell APIs)

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_mcp** (confidence high). eBay Developers Program (Browse/Inventory APIs, incl. eBay Motors UK) is self-service, and eBay publishes an official local MCP server for its public APIs.

official_mcp.name: @ebay/npm-public-api-mcp
official_mcp.note: Official local server (npx -y @ebay/npm-public-api-mcp; EBAY_CLIENT_ID/EBAY_CLIENT_SECRET, application or user token); production supports GET (read-only) calls to eBay's REST APIs incl. Buy Browse item search/get.

reason: eBay's own read-only MCP server (@ebay/npm-public-api-mcp) reaches the Browse API for any marketplace, including EBAY_GB (eBay Motors UK). developer.ebay.com answered HTTP 403 to plain and headless-Chromium fetches on 2026-09-25, so no adapter was generated from its docs. Use the vendor MCP.
